consequence.statement: After the upgrade, protocol differentiation is on by default. Existing services without a protocol set are kept as they are, to avoid connection disruptions, so they keep working without protocol differentiation. They have to be deleted and recreated for the agent to use their protocol. On a downgrade to a version without this feature, the agent deletes and recreates services that have a protocol set, without the protocol, which disrupts connections for those services.
consequence.remediation: If you need protocol differentiation for existing services, delete and recreate them after the upgrade. Before any downgrade, plan for connection disruptions on services that have a protocol set, or control the feature with --bpf-lb-proto-diff.
